structured_output.what_is_happening: CI "Chinese Intelligence" is a pump.fun coin that was created and moved to PumpSwap in the same second (created_unix = migrated_unix, 14:38:19Z). That suggests the dev or a bundle filled the whole bonding curve at launch. After 40 minutes it sat at about $235k market cap with $42k liquidity. The 1h figures are 2,905 buys against 514 sells, and 1,947 unique buyers against 156 sellers. That is roughly $110 per buy, and volume has been a steady ~$40k in every 5-minute candle. The price has swung between about $0.00016 and $0.00025 and is now close to its all-time high (~$259k market cap). The 5-minute candle timestamps as the fetch tool reported them are wrong (it showed 2025-01-24). Outside the market data I found almost no attention: 0 pump.fun replies, only 11 GMGN page visits, no web, X or Reddit hits, and a generic template website.

narrative.description: A generic 'Chinese-themed internet culture + cybernetic AI' meme. It doesn't tie to any specific event or viral post I could find. At most there is loose adjacency to the September 2026 'becoming Chinese' soft-power meme trend.
narrative.why_spreading: I found no organic trigger. The flow looks mechanical: a very high buy count, very few sellers, uniform 5-minute volume, and zero pump.fun replies.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the only 'Chinese Intelligence' token with real volume. Its site and pump.fun metadata list this contract address.
token_connection.competing_tokens: The other same-ticker CI tokens (Compute Inu, ClimbingInu, Cloud Inu, Chipotle Intelligence) are all dead with under $8k market cap and have different names.

authenticity.evidence: 1,947 buyers vs 156 sellers in the first hour, ~$110 average buys, flat ~$40k/5-minute volume, and a curve completed at the moment of creation. Against 1,800+ holders there are only 11 GMGN page visits and 0 pump.fun replies. The dev/bundler holding is 7.87%. The dev's X account has launched 3 tokens, and the GMGN community-takeover flag is set.
authenticity.uncertainty: I can't see X (x.com returned HTTP 402) or Telegram, so there could be real call-group or KOL activity I couldn't observe. GMGN's bot/degen rate is low (0.2%), which cuts against the pure-bot reading.

structural_risks: Buyer flow looks like wash or micro-buy bots, so it may reverse sharply when they stop
Price is at its high after about +290% in 40 minutes; the -50% stop is about $118k market cap and sits inside the earlier trading range
GeckoTerminal says the top 10 hold 34.6% (this may include the pool)

structured_output.counterargument: Holders are widely spread (top 10 about 10.6% excluding the pool), the LP is burned, mint and freeze are renounced, and the price is holding its high with steady buying. If the flow comes from a real Chinese-language call group I can't see, the coin could reach $480k fairly easily, since its volume is already more than 8x its liquidity per hour.
